segments.en: Hi.
Hi.
Hi, how are you?
I am from Kanyakumari. Where are you from?
I am from Coimbatore.
What is your name?
My name is Bhaskaran. What is your name?
Ani.
Okay, what do you do?
I am working in a private company. What about you?
I am working in IT.
Oh, okay, okay. Are you married?
No, single. What about you?
I am also single.
How long have you been using this app?
I have been using it for six days. What about you?
It has been two days.
How is it going for you in these two days?
It is okay.
Okay.
Tell me, bro. How is life going?
It is going well. What about you?
It is going well.
What else?
Are your family members watching this, or are you doing this for love?
They are watching. I am not doing this for love.
Okay.
What is your age?
Oh, okay, okay.
Tell me, bro.
What else?
How were people talking the other day?
It was okay, not bad. They were over-judgmental.
I have not spoken properly to anyone until now.
They cut the call without saying anything, and they keep talking. Also, there are many who are very judgmental.
Why are you using this app?
I am staying alone, so I am working, I mean, using it.
Okay, okay. Are you staying alone in Kanyakumari?
No, I am working in Bangalore. I stay alone in PG here.
I work the night shift, and during the day, I am alone.
I thought I would open it and see.
If you are in Bangalore, you should go out somewhere, right? Why are you here?
The traffic makes me want to go out. I have to stand at the signal for a long time.
It is very difficult.
Okay, okay, okay.
How is it for you? Are the calls okay?
I don't use it much. I only get calls sometimes.
Did you find any friends here?
No, I told you, I haven't spoken properly to anyone. I just come, attend two or three calls, and get annoyed, so I close it and leave.
These two days went like that. Today is the third day.
Why are you using this app?

It is not bad. They had put up ads, so I thought they would speak decently and not judge. But I saw everyone judging. When I said Bangalore, they immediately asked, 'What is your body count?' What is that? Why is it personal? Why are they asking that? If we start talking closely, that will come. If they ask such questions at the start, like 'Do you smoke or drink?', then are those who do that wrong? That is their choice. Why should it be wrong? They ask me as if it is some big thing. Nonsense.
Okay, okay, okay.
Tell me, bro. Ask me something.
What should I ask about?
Ask me anything, whatever. Ask me whatever you feel like.
Honestly, I am not the one who talks. I am like a listener. If someone is talking, I will listen. I don't know how to talk, honestly.
Okay, okay.
How is it in Bangalore? How long has it been since you went to Bangalore?
I have been in Bangalore for two years.
Two years?
Yes.
Okay, okay. How is it going?
It is going well.
Do you go out anywhere?
I don't go out much because the traffic in Bangalore is high. I only go out with friends.
Okay.
That is all. Other than that, there is no other place to see in Bangalore.
Okay, okay. Do you go with your friends?
With PG friends?
Not with PG friends, but with office mates.
Oh, you go with your office colleagues, right? Okay.
Yes, because PG mates have different commitments. We cannot take them with us.
I go with my colleagues.
Okay, okay. Do you go to Koramangala?
Not just Koramangala, but Indiranagar.
Okay, okay. Indiranagar, Marathahalli, do you go there?
Not Marathahalli, I have been to Sarjapur, and then Koramangala.
Okay, okay, okay. Which pub did you like the most?
For me? I don't like any pub.
Why?

I don't like it. I just go to give company. Because if we don't go with teammates, they will corner us, plus they will say it is outdated. They will label us if we are not in the trend. So I just go with them. I don't like the environment there.
Okay, okay. Just...
I like watching others enjoy, but I don't participate.
Are you an introvert?
I cannot say introvert. I just don't like some habits, that is all.
Okay.
The drinks, cigars, the dance there... I like watching others enjoy, but I won't be in that place.
I understand, I understand.
You yourself are restrictive in some matters.
It is not like that. It is good to have restrictions in some matters.
That is correct.
Because from my point of view, some things that I take, that is me, right?
Yes, yes, yes.
You shouldn't change what is needed for others, right?
